scope.label: Bronisław Kaper early career, documented through 1939

records.title: Ihre Majestät die Liebe
records.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper’s involvement is considered probable, but his role is not established. The only positive attribution is IMDb, which lists him as “Benjamin Kapper”; Filmportal and Walter Jurmann estate materials do not confirm it. Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht (July 1931): 152 registers the film’s song “Du bist nicht die Erste” under Walter Jurmann alone, and the film was shot in autumn 1930, before the Jurmann–Kaper collaboration began.

records.title: Little Boy Blue
records.publicNote: Animated short, also circulated as The Big Bad Wolf (1936). Buxbaum/Sieghardt associates Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann with background cues and lists Carl W. Stalling as an additional music contributor; Ub Iwerks produced and directed the film, which was distributed by MGM.
